# uzc_plans (Data Source)

Lists UzCloud plans for a given service (e.g. "Virtual Machine", "Block Storage").

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uzc_plans" "vm_plans" {
  service        = "Virtual Machine"
  cloud_provider = "nimbo"
  region         = "tashkent"
}

output "cheapest_plan_slug" {
  value = data.uzc_plans.vm_plans.plans[0].slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service` (String) Service to list plans for, e.g. "Virtual Machine".

### Optional

- `cloud_provider` (String) Filter to plans offered by this cloud provider slug.
- `region` (String) Filter to plans available in this region slug.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `plans` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))

<a id="nestedatt--plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans`

Read-Only:

- `cloud_provider_id` (String)
- `cpu` (Number) vCPU count (Virtual Machine plans only).
- `default` (Boolean)
- `hourly_price` (Number)
- `id` (String)
- `memory` (Number) Memory in MB (Virtual Machine plans only).
- `monthly_price` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `slug` (String)
- `status` (Boolean)
- `storage` (Number) Storage in GB (Virtual Machine plans only).
